name: gr-payroll
description: Running Greek payroll for 2026 (calendar year): what an employer does each month and each year. Covers hiring in ERGANI II, the APD return and payment to e-EFKA, monthly gross-to-net (employee e-EFKA contributions of 13.37% under KPK 101, then income tax withholding on pay annualised under decision ΠΟΛ 1104/2014 (monthly net pay times 14, tax divided by 14) using the 2026 scale of 9% to 44%, the youth and child rates and the art. 16 tax reduction), the Christmas and Easter bonuses, the 2026 minimum wage (EUR 880, then EUR 920 from 1 April 2026), overtime, night and Sunday premiums, the 20% withholding on extra pay, the monthly withholding return (ΦΜΥ) and its deadline, the digital work card and the fines. Trigger phrases: Greek payroll, μισθοδοσία, ΦΜΥ, παρακράτηση φόρου μισθωτών, gross to net Greece, δώρο Χριστουγέννων, κατώτατος μισθός 2026, ΕΡΓΑΝΗ, ψηφιακή κάρτα. Out of scope: contribution rates by branch (gr-employee-contributions), the employee's annual return (gr-income-tax), sel
